install.title: Install ClassKeeper
install.intro: Add ClassKeeper to your phone's home screen to open it like an app — no app store needed.
install.iosSub: Once added, open ClassKeeper straight from your home screen.
install.iosNote: Using Safari? The Share button is in the bottom bar. If “Open as Web App” appears, keep it switched on.
install.androidSub: Chrome installs ClassKeeper like a normal app — no store needed.
install.android1: Open ClassKeeper in Chrome and tap the ⋮ menu
install.android6: Find the ClassKeeper icon on your home screen
install.android7: Open it — it runs full screen like an app
install.androidNote: Other Android browsers (Edge, Samsung Internet) have a similar “Add to Home screen” item. The security check only appears on some phones.
install.signInNote: The installed app keeps its own sign-in, so you may need to sign in once more the first time you open it.
